readout_other: intrinsic signal optical imaging of CSD count and propagation speed; open field test; BDNF western blot
direction_notes: PUS reduced the count and propagation speed of CSD, more so at higher pressure; 30 min PUS improved open-field motor activity and raised BDNF.

exposures.label: PUS at CSD induction window (30 s and 30 min groups; 0.2-0.8 MPa; DC 20-80%)

timing.protocol_description: PUS of 30 s or 30 min was delivered to the induction window of CSD (1 M KCl) at 1 MHz, PRF 1 kHz, DC 50% at 0.6 MPa; pressure (0.2-0.8 MPa) and DC (20, 50, 80%) were varied in separate experiments with 30 s PUS. Pulse duration is not stated in the text.

source_quotes.n_subjects: In total, 114 Sprague Dawley rats were used in the experiments (all male, body weight 200 g, aged 5–6 weeks, Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd).
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: A schematic of the PUS experimental setup is shown in Fig. 1A. A focused ultrasound transducer (V302-SU, Olympus) with a fundamental frequency (FF) of 1 MHz and a diameter of 31 mm was used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: A schematic of the PUS experimental setup is shown in Fig. 1A. A focused ultrasound transducer (V302-SU, Olympus) with a fundamental frequency (FF) of 1 MHz and a diameter of 31 mm was used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A schematic of the PUS experimental setup is shown in Fig. 1A. A focused ultrasound transducer (V302-SU, Olympus) with a fundamental frequency (FF) of 1 MHz and a diameter of 31 mm was used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The ultrasound pressures were 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 MPa in the experiments for evaluating the inhibitory effect of PUS on CSD at different ultrasound intensities.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The ultrasound pressure, FF, pulsed repetition frequency, and duty cycle (DC) for PUS were 0.6 MPa, 1 MHz, 1 kHz, and 50%, respectively in the CSD PUS (30 s) group and the CSD PUS (30 min) group.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: To compare the inhibitory effects of ultrasound stimulation on CSD under different DCs, we compared the inhibitory effect of PUS on CSD in rat with DC of 20%, 50%, and 80%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Simultaneously, the camera started to record raw images from the imaging area, and the digital I/O card (USB-6201) sent a trigger signal to the first function generator to transmit ultrasound for 30 s or 30 min according to the sequence, as shown in Fig. 1B. The camera recorded raw images for 1000 s at 20 fps with an exposure time of 50 ms.
